name: info-overview
prompt: What is the Nori A3?

name: info-overview-alt
prompt: Give me a quick summary of this robot.

name: info-specs
prompt: What are the full specs of the Nori A3?

name: info-specs-dof
prompt: How many degrees of freedom does it have and what's the weight?

name: info-sdk-links
prompt: Where's the source code for the SDK this wraps, and what license is it under?

name: info-sdk-links-protocol
prompt: What protocol does the SDK use to talk to the robot?

name: info-predecessor
prompt: What robot did the A3 evolve from?

name: info-predecessor-carryover
prompt: What design elements carried over from XLeRobot into the A3?

name: info-community
prompt: What did Hacker News think when this launched?

name: info-community-criticism
prompt: What criticisms did people have about the A3 at launch?

name: info-actuator-upgrade
prompt: Could the actuators be upgraded to something better?

name: info-actuator-upgrade-qdd
prompt: What's the tradeoff between RC servos and quasi-direct-drive actuators here?

name: info-fleet-peers
prompt: What other MCP servers work alongside this one?

name: info-fleet-peers-training
prompt: If I record demonstrations here, what would I use to train a model on them?

name: session-connect
prompt: Connect to the robot.

name: session-connect-force-mock
prompt: Open a session but force the mock even if real credentials exist.

name: session-connect-idempotent
prompt: Make sure a session is open before we continue.

name: session-disconnect
prompt: Disconnect the current session.

name: session-status
prompt: What's the current session status?

name: session-status-mock-check
prompt: Is this the real robot or the mock right now?

name: session-status-telemetry
prompt: Check the current telemetry.

name: session-wait-ready
prompt: Wait until the robot is fully ready.

name: session-wait-ready-before-control
prompt: Make sure it's ready before we send any motion commands.

name: control-jog
prompt: Jog the left arm gently for half a second.

name: control-jog-base
prompt: Nudge the base forward briefly.

name: control-set-jog
prompt: Start moving the base forward slowly and keep going until I say stop.

name: control-clear-jog
prompt: Stop the continuous jog now.

name: control-action
prompt: Set these joint targets and wait until reached.

name: control-action-nowait
prompt: Set these joint targets without waiting for completion.

name: control-pose-right
prompt: Move the right arm to 30cm forward, 10cm right, 20cm up, and wait until it arrives.

name: control-pose-left
prompt: Move the left arm to a specific point and confirm when it arrives.

name: control-pose-orientation
prompt: Move the right gripper to this position with this orientation.

name: control-estop
prompt: Stop everything right now.

name: control-estop-safety
prompt: I'm not comfortable with this, stop.

name: control-estop-confirmed
prompt: Emergency stop and wait for confirmation, up to 5 seconds.

name: control-reset-latch
prompt: I've confirmed it's safe, clear the e-stop and let it move again.

name: control-reset-arm-left
prompt: The left arm faulted, recover it without touching the right arm.

name: control-reset-arm-right
prompt: Reset the right arm's fault state.

name: recording-session-start
description: Open recording session, no capture yet
prompt: Open a recording session but don't start capturing yet.

name: recording-episode-start
prompt: Start recording a demonstration of pouring water into a cup.

name: recording-episode-start-stacking
prompt: Begin recording me stacking three blocks.

name: recording-episode-stop
prompt: Stop the recording, keep it.

name: recording-episode-discard
prompt: Discard this episode, I made a mistake mid-recording.

name: recording-session-end
prompt: Close the recording session and keep everything I've recorded.

name: recording-session-discard
prompt: Scrap the whole session, none of it was good.

name: recording-start-shortcut
prompt: Just start recording a demonstration of opening a jar.

name: recording-stop-shortcut
prompt: Stop whatever's currently recording.

name: recording-discard-shortcut
prompt: Discard whatever's currently active.

name: recording-discard-last
prompt: Discard the last episode, keep the rest.

name: recording-status
prompt: How many episodes do I have recorded so far, and how much disk space is free?

name: recording-snapshot
prompt: Grab a camera snapshot.

name: recording-snapshot-longer-timeout
prompt: Take a still frame, give it up to 10 seconds.

name: recording-frames
prompt: What cameras are available and how are they laid out?

name: recording-set-bitrate
prompt: Turn the video bitrate down to 500kbps, I'm on a slow connection.

name: recording-set-bitrate-high
prompt: Bump the bitrate up to 2000kbps.

name: recording-set-paused-true
prompt: Pause the live video stream, I'm stepping away for a minute.

name: recording-set-paused-false
prompt: I'm back, resume the video stream.

name: help-basic
prompt: Remind me what tools are available and the order I'd normally use them in.

name: help-lost
prompt: I've lost track, what can I even do with this thing?

name: shutdown-basic
prompt: We're done for now, close the session cleanly.

name: shutdown-end-of-day
prompt: Shut down the session, I'm done for the day.

name: info-price
prompt: How much does the Nori A3 cost?

name: info-ship-date
prompt: When does this robot actually ship?

name: session-status-daemon
prompt: Is the control daemon actually running?

name: session-status-camera-layout
prompt: What cameras does it report right now?

name: control-jog-duration-short
prompt: Just barely nudge the arm, quarter second.

name: control-pose-precise
prompt: Put the left gripper exactly at x=0.15 y=0.0 z=0.4.

name: control-set-jog-then-clear
description: Set then immediately plan to clear
prompt: Start a continuous forward jog on the base, I'll tell you when to stop.

name: recording-episode-start-generic
description: Start episode with generic task label
prompt: Start recording, task label 'general manipulation test'.

name: recording-status-mid-session
prompt: How's the recording session looking so far?

name: session-connect-real-attempt
prompt: Try to connect - use the real robot if it's configured, otherwise mock is fine.

name: info-fleet-peers-vr
prompt: Is there a way to drive this with a VR headset instead of typing commands?

name: control-reset-latch-explicit-confirm
description: Reset latch with explicit safety confirmation
prompt: I've checked the room, it's clear, please clear the e-stop.

name: recording-session-start-then-pause-decision
prompt: Open a recording session, I need a minute before I start the actual take.

name: recording-discard-mistake-episode
prompt: That take went wrong, discard it, don't keep any of it.

name: control-action-gripper-close
prompt: Close the right gripper.

name: control-action-gripper-open
prompt: Open the left gripper fully.

name: session-wait-ready-timeout-context
prompt: After that arm reset, wait until it's ready again before we continue.

name: info-specs-camera-lidar
prompt: What cameras and sensors does the A3 have onboard?

name: recording-set-bitrate-default-question
prompt: Set the bitrate to a reasonable default, say 1000kbps.

name: control-estop-then-status
prompt: Stop it, then tell me the current status.

name: recording-frames-before-snapshot
prompt: Before grabbing a photo, tell me what cameras are even available.

name: info-sdk-links-dataset-format
prompt: What format do the recorded episodes end up in?

name: session-disconnect-end-of-test
prompt: That's all I needed, disconnect.

name: control-jog-negative-direction
prompt: Nudge the base backward slightly.

name: recording-episode-start-pouring-variant
prompt: Record me demonstrating how to pour coffee.

name: recording-session-end-summary
description: End session and ask for summary
prompt: Wrap up the session and tell me how many episodes I ended up with.

name: control-pose-both-arms-sequential-first
description: First of a two-arm sequential pose move
prompt: Move the left arm into position first.

name: control-pose-both-arms-sequential-second
description: Second of a two-arm sequential pose move
prompt: Now move the right arm into position too.

name: info-community-price-comparison
description: Ask about price vs competitors reaction
prompt: Did people compare the price to other research robots?

name: session-status-pre-recording-check
description: Status check before starting to record
prompt: Before we record anything, confirm the session's healthy.

name: recording-set-paused-during-break
description: Pause during a break, explicit reason
prompt: Pause streaming, I need a coffee break.

name: help-typical-order
description: Ask for typical call order specifically
prompt: What's the usual order I'd call these tools in?

name: shutdown-after-estop
prompt: Everything's stopped and safe, go ahead and shut the session down.

name: info-actuator-upgrade-bom-honesty
description: Actuator upgrade, ask for parts list explicitly
prompt: Give me a full bill of materials for the actuator upgrade.

name: control-jog-arm-up
prompt: Nudge the right arm upward just a little.

name: recording-episode-stop-then-status
description: Stop episode then immediately check status
prompt: Stop this episode and tell me how many I have total now.

name: session-connect-then-info
prompt: Connect first, then tell me the full specs.

name: control-reset-arm-after-pose-fault
description: Reset arm after a failed pose move
prompt: That pose move faulted the arm, reset it.

name: recording-snapshot-wrist-camera
description: Snapshot from a specific camera role
prompt: Grab a still from the right wrist camera.

name: info-community-XLeRobot-comparison
prompt: Did anyone compare it directly to the original XLeRobot project?

name: shutdown-mid-troubleshooting
description: Shutdown while troubleshooting a stuck session
prompt: Something seems stuck, just shut the session down and we'll reconnect fresh.
